overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two members' private work on a bylaw draft was not deliberation by a quorum. A post-complaint harassment claim was not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that three board members deliberated on a proposed hotel bylaw outside a noticed meeting, including by revising the draft before the May 4 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the work by Ms. Gardner and Ms. McCallum did not constitute deliberation by a quorum of the Board, it did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Request for further review alleged that an individual associated with the board harassed the complainant after the complaint was filed; not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation was not included in the original complaint, we do not review it now.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
